# aegntic.ai

> Mattae Cooper (@aegntic) — independent AI-agent engineer who designs, builds, and ships production AI-agent systems solo, end to end. Available for hire.

## Services
- Custom AI-agent builds — architecture through production (Rust, Go, TypeScript, Python)
- Automation systems — workflows, integrations, backends in production
- Developer tooling — Claude Code ecosystem, MCP, CLIs
- AE Audits — agent-native adversarial review (https://aegntic.ai/audits/)

## Projects
- AE Audits — Decision review for expensive bets. A structured adversarial council — 15 specialized lenses — before you commit capital, time, or reputation. (https://aegntic.ai/projects/ae-audits/)
- CLDCDE — Claude Code ecosystem hub — tools, patterns, and operator infrastructure for agentic development. (https://aegntic.ai/projects/cldcde/)
- clawREFORM — Agent-city surface for coordination, reform patterns, and multi-agent operations. (https://aegntic.ai/projects/clawreform/)
- veritas-operator — Research pipeline operator for evidence gathering, synthesis, and verification loops. (https://aegntic.ai/projects/veritas-operator/)
- obsidian-indexer — Local-first knowledge indexing for sovereign operator workflows — vaults, memory, and agent retrieval. (https://aegntic.ai/projects/obsidian-indexer/)
- Prologue — Universal MCP discovery and memory library — cut setup from hours to minutes. (https://aegntic.ai/projects/prologue/)
- tld.express — Express TLD product surface on Cloudflare Pages. (https://aegntic.ai/projects/tld-express/)
- prompt.fail — Public surface for prompt failure modes and agent edge cases. (https://aegntic.ai/projects/prompt-fail/)
- mcp.graphics — Graphics-focused MCP surface for agent-driven visual work. (https://aegntic.ai/projects/mcp-graphics/)
- unltd CLI — CLI patterns for unlimited agent operator workflows. (https://aegntic.ai/projects/unltd-cli/)
- Cognitive OS — Cognitive Operating System — the multi-harness agent policy and execution stack. (https://aegntic.ai/projects/cognitive-os/)
- Systems — memory, policy, coordination, and verification infrastructure. (https://aegntic.ai/systems/)
- Agents — purpose-built operators including Echo, veritas-operator, and obsidian-indexer. (https://aegntic.ai/agents/)
- Plugins — installable operating intelligence including Aegntic Skills and Tab Harvest. (https://aegntic.ai/plugins/)
- Products — focused products including AE Audits, CLDCDE, prompt.fail, and tld.express. (https://aegntic.ai/products/)
- zkputer — Zero-knowledge compute exploration — privacy-preserving execution patterns. (https://aegntic.ai/projects/zkputer/)
